description_en: Obtains a temporary URL for a video or audio file to allow immediate viewing
description_zh: 获取视频或语音文件临时URL，方便您立即查看视频或语音文件
name: GetTemporaryFileUrl

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the audio or video file.

You can find this ID on the Voice Files (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/files/list/voiceFiles) or Video Files (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/videoFiles/list/slot) page in the Voice Service console
parameters.help_zh:
音频或视频ID。

您可以在语音服务控制台语音文件管理 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/files/list/voiceFiles)页面或视频文件管理 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/videoFiles/list/slot)页面，查看语音ID或视频ID
parameters.name: video_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: Detailed information about why access was denied

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code for the request.

OK means the request succeeded.

For other codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）

Data.description_en:
videoFileUrl: The URL to play the file.

videoFile: The audio or video file.

fileExpireTime: The time-to-live (TTL) of the file, in milliseconds
Data.description_zh:
private String videoFileUrl：播放文件URL
private String videoFile：语音或视频文件
private Long fileExpireTime：文件过期时间，单位毫秒

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call succeeded.

true: The call succeeded.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:

true：调用成功。
